children: METROCON COMPLETES COMPLIANCE PLACEMENT; SHARES EXPECTED TO RESUME TRADING UNDER NEW NAME "METROCON"
COMPLETES COMPLIANCE PLACEMENT OF 23 MILLION SHARES AT S$0.20 PER SHARE
TRADING IN METROCON SHARES TO RESUME AT 9.00 A.M. ON SEPT 15, 2026
MPL RECORDS REVENUE OF S$24.39 MILLION AND PAT OF S$2.09 MILLION IN 1H2026
MPL SECURES S$750,000 SUB-CONTRACT FOR SOIL IMPROVEMENT WORKS IN AUGUST 2026
